description: Query DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA) for a domain and validate email-related records, including DNSSEC presence and SPF/DMARC syntax, returning severity-rated diagnostics. Use this for a single authoritative answer about one domain. Use dns_propagation instead when you need to compare answers across multiple global resolvers (e.g., right after a change), or email_auth for a full SPF/DKIM/DMARC deliverability assessment. Read-only; requires no API key or authentication; subject to rate limiting. Returns a text report: status, KPI summary, detected issues, and recommended actions.

domain.description: Registrable domain or hostname to query, without scheme or path (e.g., 'example.com' or 'mail.example.com'). Do not include 'http://' or a trailing slash.

name: dns_lookup

actions.description: Recommended next actions, most important first

grade.description: Letter grade (A+ to F) when the tool grades the target

reportUrl.description: Human-facing interactive report for this exact lookup on dechonet.com

score.description: 0-100 score when the tool scores the target

title: DNS Lookup
